notes: Implemented scraper using the site's RSS feed with pagination via polite_fetch. Initial attempts with sitemap XML failed (sitemap1 minimal, sitemap2 blocked). Fallback to RSS feed succeeded; pagination yields all articles. Parsed pubDate to filter dates 2026-09-25..2026-10-25, deduplicated URLs, wrote TSV. Verified sample URLs have >1500 chars and extracted article:published_time matching listed date. Status codes: feed pages returned 200; article fetches also 200. Final route works because RSS feed is allowed in robots.txt and supports pagination without blocking.
